name: quanthorizon
description: A quantitative algorithmic trading and market intelligence platform for the Indian Equity Markets (National Stock Exchange of India — NSE). TRADEXO scans all 210 NSE F&O Whitelisted stocks and major benchmark indices (NIFTY 50, BANK NIFTY, SENSEX, GIFT NIFTY), combining a 6-pillar technical matrix with institutional block deal tracking, multi-timeframe Smart Money Concepts (SMC), an intraday strategy engine, and transparent mathematical accuracy calibration.
